Pillar 01

NATA Laboratory Precision

Chemical & microscopic sample testing conducted exclusively through NATA-accredited facilities with 24–48 hr verified turnaround.

  • Polarised Light Microscopy (PLM) with dispersion staining
  • Definitive Chrysotile (White), Amosite (Brown) & Crocidolite (Blue) ID
  • Official NATA Endorsed Certificates of Analysis
  • Zero assumptions — scientific validation on every material
Pillar 02

Engineered Building Standards

Every structural remediation, roofing installation, and hazardous defit project adheres strictly to the National Construction Code (NCC) and Australian Standards.

  • Certified Class A & B hazardous materials supervisor oversight
  • Independent engineering sign-offs & calibrated structural testing
  • Transparent, milestone-based fixed price guarantee
  • Dedicated full-time WHS certified site managers
Pillar 03

WHS Zero-Harm Protocol

Class A (Friable) & Class B hazardous material containment utilizing negative air pressure units, HEPA H14 filtration, and 3-stage decontamination locks.

  • Continuous air quality boundary monitoring during works
  • EPA tracking & licensed waste transport manifest documentation
  • Certified exclusion zone barricading & statutory signage
  • 100% WorkSafe Queensland compliant workflows
Pillar 04

Digital Clearance & Indemnity

Independent clearance inspections and tamper-proof compliance certificates providing full legal protection for future leasing, financing, or property sales.

  • NATA certified air monitoring clearance logs (<0.01 fibers/mL)
  • Commercial 5-year Asbestos Registers & Management Plans
  • Permanent digital cloud archive access for building owners
  • Complete PCBU statutory duty compliance (WHS Reg s425 & s429)
Statutory PCBU Due Diligence

Compliance Shield™ $395 Document Review

Is your asbestos register complete? Are your contractor pre-start safety packs exposing you to statutory fines under Queensland law?

What We Audit In Your $395 Review:

Under section 425 and 429 of the Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (QLD), building owners, property managers, and body corporates face severe penalties if their asbestos register is missing, out-of-date (over 5 years old), or lacks a current Asbestos Management Plan.

  • ✓ Asbestos Register Validity Check: Verifies NATA laboratory sample records, location mapping, and condition scoring.
  • ✓ Asbestos Management Plan (AMP) Review: Confirms incident response protocols, labelling registers, and inspection schedules.
  • ✓ Demolition & Refurbishment Scope Audit: Ensures destructive survey requirements are identified before contractors commence.
  • ✓ Plain-English Gap Analysis Report: Delivered in 48 hours with clear actionable steps to achieve 100% legal indemnity.
